+-----------------------+    +----------------------------------+    +----------------------------+
| Client                |    | API                              |    | DB                         |
+-----------------------+    +----------------------------------+    +----------------------------+
| +request() : Response |    | +handle(req: Request) : Response |    | +query(sql: String) : Rows |
+-----------------------+    +----------------------------------+    +----------------------------+

relations:
id(bytes=6)="Client" --> id(bytes=3)="API" : uses
id(bytes=3)="API"    --> id(bytes=2)="DB"  : reads
id(bytes=3)="API"    ..> id(bytes=2)="DB"  : caches
